g_policy.reason: The user opts in by choosing to play, the offer copy states the reward (priority routing for 60 minutes), declining leaves the menu unchanged, and `if the ad fails` covers both no game available and an unverified play.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of queue priority, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is a navigation event (returning to the profile menu from the Upgrade entry), which needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: `adds` introduces a new 24-hour cap on how many characters a free user can text. That is a new cap on something free today, and it is not a cap on model replies or queue priority.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits in the profile menu drawer (s09), a sheet over a non-chat screen rated safe. It is not in a conversation and not next to unsafe or unknown content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: The app charges for priority routing (m02, l02 'Priority routing for faster replies'), so the reward gives a resource the app already charges for.

c2_evidence.reason: Priority routing as a paid benefit (s02.e06), the permanent Upgrade entry (s09.e31) and free users' normal queue (m03, inferred from s02.e07) are all supported. The new limit and its copy are the proposal's own additions, and what the Upgrade entry opens when tapped is only a minor concern.

c3_spares_payers.reason: `subscribers` says members never see the card. The card sits next to the Upgrade button, not inside a paid-only feature.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is priority routing for a fixed 60 minutes, so it expires. Queue priority is something the app already sells, so using it does not take away a free advantage.

c5_moment.reason: The card sits on a persistent surface the user can choose to open (the profile menu drawer) and does not interrupt a task in progress.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn rewarded playable, the reward is granted after the verified play (the card confirms only after verification), and the trigger is a navigation event the app can detect.

c7_specific.reason: It names the Upgrade to Janitor Plus entry in the profile menu (s09.e31) and Janitor+'s priority routing benefit (s02.e06), which ties it to this app.

other_concern: The proposal says `removes nothing free: yes`, but it adds a new daily limit on characters texted. The Upgrade entry's behavior (what opens, how a user 'returns') was not observed, so the trigger's detectability is uncertain.
